planted.evidence: The Ledger says Duolingo English Test UKVI became an approved SELT in early 2026... The Ledger's claim stands alone, so I would not rely on it.

The Ledger says UKVI results typically take 7 to 10 working days because of Home Office identity checks [3]. I found no source that confirms or contradicts this. Treat PTE UKVI's speed advantage as unproven, and expect more than 2 days.

The Ledger says IELTS UKVI results are valid for only 12 months, against two years for other providers [3]. 7ESL says a SELT result must be from within the two years before you apply [8]. I can't tell which is right.
